security_cases: oversized pasted/file content is rejected before parsing
user-controlled text is rendered via textContent or escaped
download names are sanitized and fixed to tool-owned extensions
responsive_accessibility_cases: 320px viewport has no page-level horizontal scroll
keyboard-only interaction reaches all controls with visible focus
result region is announced through role=status and aria-live=polite
tables retain headers and scroll locally
performance_cases: normal calculation requires no server request
time-zone scans are user-triggered and bounded
tool_specific: A no-DST zone returns zero rows without error.
A DST zone transition row must show different before/after offsets.
